description: This file contains unit test cases for the VacancyAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It tests create, update, delete, getAll, and getOne API endpoints using various test data providers and mocks.

classes.name: VacancyAPITest
classes.description: A test suite for the VacancyAPI endpoints, validating their integration and behavior within the recruitment module.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a vacancy via the VacancyAPI using provided test cases.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update functionality of an existing vacancy in the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of a vacancy using the API.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Verifies retrieving all vacancy records through the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Checks fetching a single vacancy record from the API.
